messages:
Sasha: Quick draft: 'Peer feedback spark notes' 1-line pasteables for fast peer reviews and upward feedback. Goal: make peer feedback specific, actionable, and short so folks actually leave it. Feedback?

Mei: Love it  can we include an anonymized option for cross-team reviews? Also add a 1-line 'what to avoid' (no personality critiques).

Darren: Suggest we add a tiny rubric: 'Behavior, Evidence, Impact, Suggestion' (B.E.I.S) and then show a 3-line example using that.

Sasha: Great call. Added B.E.I.S and anonymized variant. Pasteables below (copy-paste into review forms):

- Peer feedback (3 lines, B.E.I.S):
  1) Behavior: "Consistently adds clear acceptance criteria to tickets."
  2) Evidence: "Example: ticket #789 had clear ACs which prevented 2 reworks in QA."
  3) Impact + Suggestion: "Resulted in faster merges; suggestion: pair on two upcoming specs to share pattern."

- Upward feedback (2 lines, concise):
  - "Appreciate the clearer roadmap priorities this quarter (behavior). It helped me focus on X (impact)."
  - "One ask: earlier heads-up on timeline shifts would help planning (suggestion)."

- Anonymized cross-team quick: (1 line)
  - "Peer note: 'Appreciate faster review cycles on infra PRs; please keep the weekday grooming slots.'"
  - "(To anonymize: remove names and attach team tag, e.g., 'from infra-eng')."

- What to avoid (1 line):
  - "Avoid judging intent or using personality descriptors; focus on observable behavior and outcome."

- Calibration snippet (paste into manager notes):
  - "Recommend elevating to 'team collaboration' highlight if >2 peers note the same behavior; flag any conflicting signals for discussion in calibration."

- Tiny manager coaching prompts (1-liners to use in 1:1):
  - "Which peer feedback surprised you and why?"
  - "What small change would make the most difference next sprint?"
  - "Which feedback should we prioritize owning as a team?"

Mei: These are clean. Can we add a 1-line template for peers giving feedback on non-deliverable work (mentoring, onboarding)?

Sasha: Added: "Mentoring note: 'Provided 1:1 onboarding sessions and checklist; new hire reached ramp milestones 2 weeks faster.'"

people-ops-bot: Saved to /templates/feedback/peer-spark-notes  public and scheduled a short broadcast to leads tomorrow 10am PT.

Darren: I'll pilot the anonymized form in our cross-team retro and report back. Thanks!

Sasha: Thanks everyone  will pin and add a 5-min demo to the leads sync agenda.
